summary: The Module 3 standalone work meets the task requirements and honours the HARD BOUNDARIES and the credit-memo governing principles. Verified by reading the full diff and running tests: (1) the exported m3_corporate_structure.json is de-wrapped so its root is schema_version/artifact_type/visual_spec/companies (via build_m3_corporate_structure_export), matching the reference final-output root key set, with the governed internal record (artifact id + provenance + round-trip) moved to a separate m3_structure_provenance.json sidecar; (2) Validator 7 is hardened — completion status is consistent (incomplete when A and B both absent, partial when only B assessed, complete only when both present, never silently complete), rejected/material-unverified findings are excluded from consolidated_conclusion via _is_admitted while every rejected/unresolved item is retained under evidence_verification, and a deterministic numeric/period entailment gate downgrades claims whose cited evidence does not contain the asserted value/period so a resolving citation id is never treated as entailment; (3) the credibility-vs-credit-direction distinction is enforced in _govern_finding (a credible supported/qualified explanation of a negative/mixed observation keeps its negative credit_direction, records a credibility_vs_direction_note and an m3.credibility_vs_direction issue) and is explicitly tested; (4) run_m3 invokes only the m3_corporate_management specialist via prepare_specialist + run_single_pass with V3_SPEC_BY_CODE['M3'] plus Validator 7 and deterministic structure processing, invokes no orchestrator/challenger/synthesis/scoring/memo/other specialist, and the integration test asserts exactly one AgenticAnalysisRun, one evidence packet for m3_corporate_management, and no forbidden downstream audit events; (5) the management benchmark is 8 REAL admitted HCA FY2025 10-K verbatim excerpts whose manifest sha256 hashes resolve against the tracked files, each carrying independent credibility and credit_direction labels marked developer_authored_awaiting_external_review, including the required credible-adverse (M3-03) and unsupported-causal-attribution (M3-05) cases; (6) schema changes are additive/versioned/backward-compatible (credit_direction and credibility_vs_direction_note added to ManagementObservation with defaults; new export built by a new function; legacy builder retained as a deprecated alias); and (7) the full offline suite runs 1410 passed / 131 skipped / 12 errors, the 12 being exactly the known pre-existing test_bo_recorded_completion.py environment errors (missing untracked output/bo/HCA_M3_REFINEMENT_LIVE_20261018_R5 dir, absent on the base branch too), with zero new failures and no weakened expectations. No blocking findings remain.

findings.detail: The negative-direction / credibility-vs-direction cases are proven at the validator seam by supplying credit_direction directly to validate_m3_assessment, because the specialist proposal schema (BO_M3_JSON_SCHEMA, additionalProperties:false) does not accept credit_direction. This is a correct and documented limitation (credit_direction is a validator-added field), but it means the distinction is only exercised at the validator boundary, not end-to-end from a scripted specialist proposal. Optional future hardening: thread an observed credit direction through the specialist contract so the distinction is also demonstrated from the model-proposal side.

The deterministic entailment gate matches numeric/period surface tokens (e.g. '51%', 'FY2024') as substrings against the cited evidence text. This is intentionally conservative and fail-closed (unmatched -> downgrade), but it can only catch value/period mismatches it can tokenise; purely qualitative unsupported inferences still rely on the existing evidence-sufficiency and management-proxy downgrades. No change required for this task; noted so reviewers understand the scope of the machine-checkable gate.
